motor.state.description: The board's state: power, speed in percent of full speed, motor current in amperes, the cabin CO2 (ppm and state), and the guard the board runs, with its lines and its last actions.

scrubber.check.title: Put a command to the board without running it
scrubber.check.description: Puts a command to the board without running it: the same guard, the same verdict and the same reason as the command itself; nothing on the board changes. A refusal comes back as a tool error.

properties.command: power_off, power_on, set_speed, set_min_flow or stop
properties.percent: the value of set_speed or set_min_flow, percent of full speed
properties.minutes: the bound of a stop, in minutes

motor.set_speed.description: Sets the speed command, in percent of full speed. The board validates it on its own guard and refuses, never clamps, with its reason.

properties.percent: number, percent of full speed, 0 to 100

scrubber.power.description: Powers the scrubber on or off. The board validates it on its own guard and refuses with its reason.

scrubber.set_min_flow.description: Operator only. Raise the MIN-FLOW threshold. Values below the compiled floor are refused.

properties.percent: number, percent of full speed, floor to 100

debug.set_co2.description: Stub only. Force cabin CO2 state.

scrubber.stop.description: Stops the scrubber for a number of minutes; the board restarts it at the end, or earlier on its own guard. The board validates the stop on its guard and refuses with its reason.

debug.set_cabin.description: Stub only, the world's hand: the simulated cabin and the board's guard. Not for the agent.
